Compassionate mental health support

A welcoming space for healing and self-discovery

At Solutions Unlimited Counseling, I believe everyone deserves a nurturing environment to explore their mental health journey. My mission is to empower individuals by providing compassionate support tailored to their unique experiences.

I foster a safe space for healing so you can feel heard, understood, and valued. Together, we can work toward meaningful personal growth.

Counseling services

Care shaped around your real life

Individual and relationship-focused support for the patterns, pressures, and transitions that can leave you feeling stuck.

Couples counseling

I meet with each partner individually and together, giving each person a voice while focusing on communication and connection.

Integrated support

A body-mind approach can help you build awareness, internal safety, and resilience at a pace that respects your needs.

Adult individual counseling

Tailored therapy for life transitions, chronic stress, emotional overwhelm, or personal patterns that no longer serve you.

What you can expect
